speaker: god
name: God
text: Let there be light,

speaker: god
text: day,

speaker: god
text: night.

speaker: god
text: Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.

speaker: god
text: sky.

speaker: god
text: Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.

speaker: god
text: earth,

speaker: god
text: seas.

speaker: god
text: Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.

speaker: god
text: Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.

speaker: god
text: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.

speaker: god
text: Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.

speaker: god
text: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.

speaker: god
text: Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.

speaker: god
text: Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.

speaker: god
text: Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.

speaker: god
text: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.

speaker: god
name: God
text: You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,

speaker: god
text: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.

speaker: god
text: It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.

speaker: adam
name: Adam
text: This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.

speaker: adam
text: woman,

speaker: serpent
name: The serpent
text: Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’

speaker: god
name: God
text: You must not eat from any tree in the garden?

speaker: eve
name: Eve
text: We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden,

speaker: eve
text: but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.’

speaker: god
text: You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.

speaker: serpent
text: You will not surely die,

speaker: serpent
text: For God knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.

speaker: god
text: Where are you?

speaker: adam
name: Adam
text: I heard Your voice in the garden,

speaker: adam
text: and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.

speaker: god
text: Who told you that you were naked?

speaker: god
text: Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?

speaker: adam
text: The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.

speaker: god
text: What is this you have done?

speaker: eve
text: The serpent deceived me,

speaker: eve
text: and I ate.

speaker: god
text: Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.

speaker: god
text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.

speaker: god
text: I will sharply increase your pain in childbirth; in pain you will bring forth children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.

speaker: god
text: Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.

speaker: god
text: Both thorns and thistles it will yield for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.

speaker: god
text: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.

speaker: god
text: Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...

speaker: eve
name: Eve
text: With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,

speaker: god
name: God
text: Why are you angry,

speaker: god
text: and why has your countenance fallen?

speaker: god
text: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.

speaker: cain
name: Cain
text: Let us go out to the field.

speaker: god
text: Where is your brother Abel?

speaker: cain
text: I do not know!

speaker: cain
text: Am I my brother’s keeper?

speaker: god
text: What have you done?

speaker: god
text: The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.

speaker: god
text: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

speaker: god
text: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.

speaker: cain
text: My punishment is greater than I can bear.

speaker: cain
text: Behold, this day You have driven me from the face of the earth, and from Your face I will be hidden; I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.

speaker: god
text: Not so!

speaker: god
text: If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.

speaker: lamech-of-cain
name: Lamech (descendant of Cain)
text: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.

speaker: lamech-of-cain
text: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.

speaker: eve
text: God has granted me another seed in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.

speaker: god
name: God
text: man.

speaker: lamech-of-seth
name: Lamech (father of Noah)
text: May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.

speaker: god
name: God
text: My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.

speaker: god
text: I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.

speaker: god
text: The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.

speaker: god
text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.

speaker: god
text: And this is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

speaker: god
text: You are to make a roof for the ark, finish its walls a cubit from the top, place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.

speaker: god
text: And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.

speaker: god
text: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

speaker: god
text: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.

speaker: god
text: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.

speaker: god
text: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

speaker: god
text: You are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate; a pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate;

speaker: god
text: and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.

speaker: god
text: For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing I have made.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Come out of the ark, you and your wife, along with your sons and their wives.

speaker: god
text: Bring out all the living creatures that are with you—birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground—so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.

speaker: god
text: Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.

speaker: god
text: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

speaker: god
text: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.

speaker: god
text: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.

speaker: god
text: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.

speaker: god
text: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:

speaker: god
text: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.

speaker: god
text: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,

speaker: god
text: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.

speaker: god
text: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.

speaker: god
text: This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

speaker: god
text: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.

speaker: god
text: Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,

speaker: god
text: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.

speaker: god
text: And whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth.

speaker: god
text: This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.

speaker: noah
name: Noah
text: Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.

speaker: noah
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.

speaker: noah
text: May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant.

speaker: unnamed-people
name: Unnamed people
text: Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.

speaker: builders-of-babel
name: The builders of Babel
text: Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.

speaker: builders-of-babel
text: Come,

speaker: builders-of-babel
text: let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.

speaker: god
name: God
text: If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.

speaker: god
text: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.

speaker: god
text: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.

speaker: god
text: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.

speaker: god
text: I will give this land to your offspring.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman,

speaker: abraham
text: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.

speaker: egyptians
name: The Egyptians
text: This is his wife.

speaker: abraham
text: Please say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.

speaker: pharaoh
name: Pharaoh
text: What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?

speaker: pharaoh
text: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!

speaker: abraham
text: She is my sister,

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. After all, we are brothers.

speaker: abraham
text: Is not the whole land before you? Now separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; if you go to the right, I will go to the left.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,

speaker: god
text: for all the land that you see, I will give to you and your offspring forever.

speaker: god
text: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.

speaker: god
text: Get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for I will give it to you.

speaker: melchizedek
name: Melchizedek
text: Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

speaker: melchizedek
text: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.

speaker: king-of-sodom
name: The king of Sodom
text: Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

speaker: abraham
text: that I will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

speaker: king-of-sodom
text: I have made Abram rich.

speaker: abraham
text: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?

speaker: abraham
text: Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.

speaker: god
text: This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.

speaker: god
text: Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.

speaker: god
text: So shall your offspring be.

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.

speaker: abraham
text: Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?

speaker: god
text: Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.

speaker: god
text: Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

speaker: god
text: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.

speaker: god
text: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.

speaker: god
text: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.

speaker: god
text: To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—

speaker: god
text: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

speaker: god
text: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,

speaker: god
text: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.

speaker: sarah
name: Sarah (Sarai)
text: Look now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.

speaker: sarah
text: May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Here,

speaker: abraham
text: your servant is in your hands. Do whatever you want with her.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
name: The angel of the LORD
text: Hagar, servant of Sarai,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: where have you come from, and where are you going?

speaker: hagar
name: Hagar
text: I am running away from my mistress Sarai,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: I will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: He will be a wild donkey of a man, and his hand will be against everyone, and everyone’s hand against him; he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.

speaker: hagar
text: You are the God who sees me,

speaker: hagar
text: Here I have seen the One who sees me!

speaker: god
name: God
text: I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.

speaker: god
text: I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.

speaker: god
text: As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

speaker: god
text: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

speaker: god
text: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.

speaker: god
text: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

speaker: god
text: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.

speaker: god
text: You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.

speaker: god
text: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.

speaker: god
text: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.

speaker: god
text: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.

speaker: god
text: Whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.

speaker: god
text: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.

speaker: god
text: As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.

speaker: god
text: And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?

speaker: abraham
text: O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!

speaker: god
text: Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac. I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

speaker: god
text: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.

speaker: god
text: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: My lord,

speaker: abraham
text: if I have found favor in your sight, please do not pass your servant by.

speaker: abraham
text: Let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.

speaker: abraham
text: And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves. This is why you have passed your servant’s way. After that, you may continue on your way.

speaker: three-men
name: The three men
text: Yes,

speaker: three-men
text: you may do as you have said.

speaker: abraham
text: Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour, knead it, and bake some bread.

speaker: three-men
text: Where is your wife Sarah?

speaker: abraham
text: There, in the tent,

speaker: god
name: God
text: I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!

speaker: sarah
name: Sarah (Sarai)
text: After I am worn out and my master is old, will I now have this pleasure?

speaker: god
text: Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’

speaker: sarah
text: Can I really bear a child when I am old?

speaker: god
text: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.

speaker: sarah
text: I did not laugh.

speaker: god
text: No,

speaker: god
text: but you did laugh.

speaker: god
text: Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

speaker: god
text: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.

speaker: god
text: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.

speaker: god
text: The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,

speaker: god
text: I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out.

speaker: abraham
text: Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

speaker: abraham
text: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city? Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there?

speaker: abraham
text: Far be it from You to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?

speaker: god
text: If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.

speaker: abraham
text: Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord—though I am but dust and ashes—

speaker: abraham
text: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five?

speaker: god
text: If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it.

speaker: abraham
text: Suppose forty are found there?

speaker: god
text: On account of the forty, I will not do it.

speaker: abraham
text: May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak further. Suppose thirty are found there?

speaker: god
text: If I find thirty there, I will not do it.

speaker: abraham
text: Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord, suppose twenty are found there?

speaker: god
text: On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it.

speaker: abraham
text: May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak once more. Suppose ten are found there?

speaker: god
text: On account of the ten, I will not destroy it.

speaker: lot
name: Lot
text: My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.

speaker: two-angels
name: The two angels
text: No,

speaker: two-angels
text: we will spend the night in the square.

speaker: men-of-sodom
name: The men of Sodom
text: Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!

speaker: lot
text: Please, my brothers,

speaker: lot
text: don’t do such a wicked thing!

speaker: lot
text: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.

speaker: men-of-sodom
text: Get out of the way!

speaker: men-of-sodom
text: This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.

speaker: two-angels
text: Do you have anyone else here—a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,

speaker: two-angels
text: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.

speaker: lot
text: Get up,

speaker: lot
text: Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!

speaker: two-angels
text: Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.

speaker: angel
name: The angel
text: Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!

speaker: lot
text: No, my lords, please!

speaker: lot
text: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.

speaker: lot
text: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place? Then my life will be saved.

speaker: angel
text: Very well,

speaker: angel
text: I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.

speaker: angel
text: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.

speaker: lots-older-daughter
name: Lot’s older daughter
text: Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.

speaker: lots-older-daughter
text: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.

speaker: lots-older-daughter
text: Look, I slept with my father last night. Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: She is my sister.

speaker: god
name: God
text: You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.

speaker: abimelech
name: Abimelech
text: Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?

speaker: abimelech
text: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.

speaker: abraham
text: She is my sister

speaker: sarah
name: Sarah (Sarai)
text: He is my brother.

speaker: god
text: Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.

speaker: god
text: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die—you and all who belong to you.

speaker: abimelech
text: What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done.

speaker: abimelech
text: What prompted you to do such a thing?

speaker: abraham
text: I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’

speaker: abraham
text: Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.

speaker: abraham
text: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.

speaker: abraham
text: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’

speaker: abraham
text: This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”

speaker: sarah
text: He is my brother.

speaker: abimelech
text: Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.

speaker: abimelech
text: See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.

speaker: sarah
name: Sarah (Sarai)
text: God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.

speaker: sarah
text: Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.

speaker: sarah
text: Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac!

speaker: god
name: God
text: Do not be distressed about the boy and your maidservant. Listen to everything that Sarah tells you, for through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.

speaker: god
text: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.

speaker: hagar
name: Hagar
text: I cannot bear to watch the boy die!

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
name: The angel of the LORD
text: What is wrong, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he lies.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Get up, lift up the boy, and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.

speaker: abimelech-and-phicol
name: Abimelech and Phicol
text: God is with you in all that you do.
tag: Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army

speaker: abimelech-and-phicol
text: Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: I swear it.

speaker: abimelech
name: Abimelech
text: I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.

speaker: abimelech
text: Why have you set apart these seven ewe lambs?

speaker: abraham
text: You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Abraham!

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Here I am,

speaker: god
text: Take your son,

speaker: god
text: your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you.

speaker: abraham
text: Stay here with the donkey,

speaker: abraham
text: The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.

speaker: isaac
name: Isaac
text: My father!

speaker: abraham
text: Here I am, my son,

speaker: isaac
text: The fire and the wood are here,

speaker: isaac
text: but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?

speaker: abraham
text: God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
name: The angel of the LORD
text: Abraham, Abraham!

speaker: abraham
text: Here I am,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.

speaker: unnamed-people
name: Unnamed people
text: On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor:

speaker: unnamed-informants
text: Uz the firstborn, his brother Buz, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

speaker: unnamed-informants
text: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.

speaker: hittites
name: The Hittites
text: Listen to us, sir. You are God’s chosen one among us. Bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. None of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.

speaker: abraham
text: If you are willing for me to bury my dead,

speaker: abraham
text: listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf

speaker: abraham
text: to sell me the cave of Machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. Let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that I may have a burial site.

speaker: ephron
name: Ephron
text: No, my lord. Listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.

speaker: abraham
text: If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.

speaker: ephron
text: Listen to me, my lord. The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.

speaker: abraham
name: Abraham (Abram)
text: Place your hand under my thigh,

speaker: abraham
text: and I will have you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,

speaker: abraham
text: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac.

speaker: unnamed-servant
name: Abraham’s chief servant
text: What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?

speaker: abraham
text: Make sure that you do not take my son back there.

speaker: abraham
text: The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.

speaker: god
name: God
text: To your offspring I will give this land
tag: The LORD, the God of heaven

speaker: abraham
text: And if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: O LORD, God of my master Abraham,

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Here I am, standing beside the spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar that I may drink,’ and who responds, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well’—let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Please let down your jar that I may drink,

speaker: rebekah
name: Rebekah
text: Drink, and I will water your camels as well

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Please let me have a little water from your jar.

speaker: rebekah
text: Drink, my lord,

speaker: rebekah
text: I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Whose daughter are you?

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?

speaker: rebekah
text: I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor.

speaker: rebekah
text: We have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.

speaker: rebekah
text: The man said this to me,

speaker: laban
name: Laban
text: Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,

speaker: laban
text: Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: I will not eat until I have told you what I came to say.

speaker: laban
text: Please speak.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: I am Abraham’s servant,

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,

speaker: abraham
text: You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son.’

speaker: abraham
text: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: What if the woman will not come back with me?

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: And he told me, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.

speaker: abraham
text: The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’

speaker: abraham
text: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Here I am, standing beside this spring. Now if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, ‘Please let me drink a little water from your jar,’

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Please let me drink a little water from your jar,

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: and she replies, ‘Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,’ may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.

speaker: rebekah
text: Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: And before I had finished praying in my heart, there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. So I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Please give me a drink.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well.’ So I drank, and she also watered the camels.

speaker: rebekah
text: Drink, and I will water your camels as well.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She replied, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Whose daughter are you?

speaker: rebekah
text: The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD; and I blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, let me know, so that I may go elsewhere.

speaker: laban-and-bethuel
name: Laban and Bethuel
text: This is from the LORD; we have no choice in the matter.

speaker: laban-and-bethuel
text: Rebekah is here before you. Take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, just as the LORD has decreed.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Send me on my way to my master.

speaker: laban-and-rebekahs-mother
name: Rebekah’s brother and mother
text: Let the girl remain with us ten days or so. After that, she may go.

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: Do not delay me, since the LORD has made my journey a success. Send me on my way so that I may go to my master.

speaker: laban-and-rebekahs-mother
text: We will call the girl and ask her opinion.

speaker: laban-and-rebekahs-mother
text: Will you go with this man?

speaker: rebekah
text: I will go,

speaker: laban-and-rebekahs-mother
text: Our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.

speaker: rebekah
text: Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?

speaker: unnamed-servant
text: It is my master,

speaker: rebekah
name: Rebekah
text: Why is this happening to me?

speaker: god
name: God
text: Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.

speaker: esau
name: Esau
text: Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: First sell me your birthright,

speaker: esau
text: Look,

speaker: esau
text: I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?

speaker: jacob
text: Swear to me first,

speaker: god
name: God
text: Do not go down to Egypt. Settle in the land where I tell you.

speaker: god
text: Stay in this land as a foreigner, and I will be with you and bless you. For I will give all these lands to you and your offspring, and I will confirm the oath that I swore to your father Abraham.

speaker: god
text: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed,

speaker: god
text: because Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.

speaker: isaac
name: Isaac
text: She is my sister.

speaker: isaac
text: She is my wife,

speaker: isaac
text: The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.

speaker: abimelech
name: Abimelech
text: So she is really your wife! How could you say, ‘She is my sister’?

speaker: isaac
text: She is my sister

speaker: isaac
text: Because I thought I might die on account of her.

speaker: abimelech
text: What is this you have done to us?

speaker: abimelech
text: One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.

speaker: abimelech
text: Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.

speaker: abimelech
text: Depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.

speaker: herdsmen-of-gerar
name: The herdsmen of Gerar
text: The water is ours!

speaker: isaac
text: At last the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.

speaker: god
text: I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham.

speaker: isaac
text: Why have you come to me?

speaker: isaac
text: You hated me and sent me away.

speaker: abimelech-ahuzzath-and-phicol
name: Abimelech, Ahuzzath, and Phicol
text: We can plainly see that the LORD has been with you,

speaker: abimelech-ahuzzath-and-phicol
text: We recommend that there should now be an oath between us and you. Let us make a covenant with you

speaker: abimelech-ahuzzath-and-phicol
text: that you will not harm us, just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you, sending you on your way in peace. And now you are blessed by the LORD.

speaker: isaacs-servants
name: Isaac’s servants
text: We have found water!

speaker: isaac
name: Isaac
text: My son.

speaker: esau
name: Esau
text: Here I am,

speaker: isaac
text: Look,

speaker: isaac
text: I am now old, and I do not know the day of my death.

speaker: isaac
text: Take your weapons—your quiver and bow—and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.

speaker: isaac
text: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die.

speaker: rebekah
name: Rebekah
text: Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,

speaker: rebekah
text: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.’

speaker: isaac
text: Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.

speaker: rebekah
text: Now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you.

speaker: rebekah
text: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father—the kind he loves.

speaker: rebekah
text: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, but I am smooth-skinned.

speaker: jacob
text: What if my father touches me? Then I would be revealed to him as a deceiver, and I would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing.

speaker: rebekah
text: Your curse be on me, my son. Just obey my voice and go get them for me.

speaker: jacob
text: My father.

speaker: isaac
text: Here I am!

speaker: isaac
text: Which one are you, my son?

speaker: jacob
text: I am Esau, your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.

speaker: isaac
text: How did you ever find it so quickly, my son?

speaker: jacob
text: Because the LORD your God brought it to me,

speaker: isaac
text: Please come closer so I can touch you, my son. Are you really my son Esau, or not?

speaker: isaac
text: The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

speaker: isaac
text: Are you really my son Esau?

speaker: jacob
text: I am.

speaker: isaac
text: Serve me,

speaker: isaac
text: and let me eat some of my son’s game, so that I may bless you.

speaker: isaac
text: Please come near and kiss me, my son.

speaker: isaac
text: Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.

speaker: isaac
text: May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth— an abundance of grain and new wine.

speaker: isaac
text: May peoples serve you and nations bow down to you. May you be the master of your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed, and those who bless you be blessed.

speaker: esau
text: My father, sit up and eat of your son’s game, so that you may bless me.

speaker: isaac
text: Who are you?

speaker: esau
text: I am Esau, your firstborn son,

speaker: isaac
text: Who was it, then, who hunted the game and brought it to me? Before you came in, I ate it all and blessed him—and indeed, he will be blessed!

speaker: esau
text: Bless me too, O my father!

speaker: isaac
text: Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.

speaker: esau
text: Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has cheated me twice. He took my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing.

speaker: esau
text: Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?

speaker: isaac
text: Look, I have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants; I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What is left that I can do for you, my son?

speaker: esau
text: Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!

speaker: isaac
text: Behold, your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land, away from the dew of heaven above.

speaker: isaac
text: You shall live by the sword and serve your brother. But when you rebel, you will tear his yoke from your neck.

speaker: esau
text: The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob.

speaker: rebekah
text: Look, your brother Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you.

speaker: rebekah
text: So now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.

speaker: rebekah
text: Stay with him for a while, until your brother’s fury subsides—

speaker: rebekah
text: until your brother’s rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?

speaker: rebekah
text: I am weary of my life because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them, what good is my life?

speaker: isaac
name: Isaac
text: Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,

speaker: isaac
text: Go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

speaker: isaac
text: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.

speaker: isaac
text: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.

speaker: isaac
text: Do not marry a Canaanite woman,

speaker: god
name: God
text: I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.

speaker: god
text: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.

speaker: god
text: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.

speaker: jacob
text: How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!

speaker: jacob
text: If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,

speaker: jacob
text: so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.

speaker: jacob
text: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: My brothers,

speaker: jacob
text: where are you from?

speaker: shepherds-of-haran
name: The shepherds from Haran
text: We are from Haran,

speaker: jacob
text: Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor?

speaker: shepherds-of-haran
text: We know him,

speaker: jacob
text: Is he well?

speaker: shepherds-of-haran
text: Yes,

speaker: shepherds-of-haran
text: and here comes his daughter Rachel with his sheep.

speaker: jacob
text: Look,

speaker: jacob
text: it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.

speaker: shepherds-of-haran
text: We cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.

speaker: laban
name: Laban
text: You are indeed my own flesh and blood.

speaker: laban
text: Just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.

speaker: jacob
text: I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel.

speaker: laban
text: Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.

speaker: jacob
text: Grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and I want to sleep with her.

speaker: jacob
text: What have you done to me?

speaker: jacob
text: Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you? Why have you deceived me?

speaker: laban
text: It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.

speaker: laban
text: Finish this week’s celebration, and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work.

speaker: leah
name: Leah
text: The LORD has seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.

speaker: leah
text: Because the LORD has heard that I am unloved, He has given me this son as well.

speaker: leah
text: Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.

speaker: leah
text: This time I will praise the LORD.

speaker: rachel
name: Rachel
text: Give me children, or I will die!

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: Am I in the place of God, who has withheld children from you?

speaker: rachel
text: Here is my maidservant Bilhah. Sleep with her, that she may bear children for me, so that through her I too can build a family.

speaker: rachel
text: God has vindicated me; He has heard my plea and given me a son.

speaker: rachel
text: In my great struggles, I have wrestled with my sister and won.

speaker: leah
name: Leah
text: How fortunate!

speaker: leah
text: How happy I am! For the women call me happy.

speaker: rachel
text: Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.

speaker: leah
text: Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?

speaker: rachel
text: Very well,

speaker: rachel
text: he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes.

speaker: leah
text: You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.

speaker: leah
text: God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband.

speaker: leah
text: God has given me a good gift,

speaker: leah
text: This time my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons.

speaker: rachel
text: God has taken away my shame,

speaker: rachel
text: May the LORD add to me another son.

speaker: jacob
text: Send me on my way so I can return to my homeland.

speaker: jacob
text: Give me my wives and children for whom I have served you, that I may go on my way. You know how hard I have worked for you.

speaker: laban
name: Laban
text: If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.

speaker: laban
text: Name your wages, and I will pay them.

speaker: jacob
text: You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.

speaker: jacob
text: Indeed, you had very little before my arrival, but now your wealth has increased many times over. The LORD has blessed you wherever I set foot. But now, when may I also provide for my own household?

speaker: laban
text: What can I give you?

speaker: jacob
text: You do not need to give me anything,

speaker: jacob
text: If you do this one thing for me, I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.

speaker: jacob
text: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb, and every spotted or speckled goat. These will be my wages.

speaker: jacob
text: So my honesty will testify for me when you come to check on my wages in the future. If I have any goats that are not speckled or spotted, or any lambs that are not dark-colored, they will be considered stolen.

speaker: laban
text: Agreed,

speaker: laban
text: Let it be as you have said.

speaker: labans-sons
name: Laban’s sons
text: Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father’s expense.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: I can see from your father’s countenance that his attitude toward me has changed; but the God of my father has been with me.

speaker: jacob
text: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.

speaker: jacob
text: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.

speaker: jacob
text: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore speckled offspring. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore streaked offspring.

speaker: laban
name: Laban
text: The speckled will be your wages,

speaker: laban
text: The streaked will be your wages,

speaker: jacob
text: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me.

speaker: jacob
text: When the flocks were breeding, I saw in a dream that the streaked, spotted, and speckled males were mating with the females.

speaker: jacob
text: In that dream the angel of God said to me, ‘Jacob!’ And I replied, ‘Here I am.’

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
name: The angel of the LORD
text: Jacob!

speaker: jacob
text: Here I am.

speaker: jacob
text: ‘Look up,’ he said, ‘and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Look up,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.

speaker: jacob
text: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me. Now get up and leave this land at once, and return to your native land.’

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me. Now get up and leave this land at once, and return to your native land.

speaker: rachel-and-leah
name: Rachel and Leah
text: Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house?

speaker: rachel-and-leah
text: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders? Not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.

speaker: rachel-and-leah
text: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.

speaker: god
text: Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.

speaker: laban
text: What have you done? You have deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war!

speaker: laban
text: Why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.

speaker: laban
text: But you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. Now you have done a foolish thing.

speaker: laban
text: I have power to do you great harm, but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’

speaker: god
text: Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.

speaker: laban
text: Now you have gone off because you long for your father’s house. But why have you stolen my gods?

speaker: jacob
text: I was afraid,

speaker: jacob
text: for I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.

speaker: jacob
text: If you find your gods with anyone here, he shall not live! In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself if anything is yours, and take it back.

speaker: rachel
name: Rachel
text: Sir, do not be angry that I cannot stand up before you; for I am having my period.

speaker: jacob
text: What is my crime?

speaker: jacob
text: For what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me?

speaker: jacob
text: You have searched all my goods! Have you found anything that belongs to you? Put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us.

speaker: jacob
text: I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flock.

speaker: jacob
text: I did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day or night.

speaker: jacob
text: As it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

speaker: jacob
text: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household—fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks—and you have changed my wages ten times!

speaker: jacob
text: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.

speaker: laban
text: These daughters are my daughters, these sons are my sons, and these flocks are my flocks! Everything you see is mine! Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne?

speaker: laban
text: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.

speaker: jacob
text: Gather some stones.

speaker: laban
text: This mound is a witness between you and me this day.

speaker: laban
text: May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other.

speaker: laban
text: If you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.

speaker: laban
text: Here is the mound, and here is the pillar I have set up between you and me.

speaker: laban
text: This mound is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this mound to harm you, and you will not go past this mound and pillar to harm me.

speaker: laban
text: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: This is the camp of God.

speaker: jacob
text: You are to say to my master Esau, ‘Your servant Jacob says: I have been staying with Laban and have remained there until now.

speaker: jacobs-messengers
name: Jacob’s messengers
text: Your servant Jacob says: I have been staying with Laban and have remained there until now.

speaker: jacob
text: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.’

speaker: jacobs-messengers
text: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.

speaker: jacobs-messengers
text: We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you—he and four hundred men with him.

speaker: jacob
text: If Esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.

speaker: jacob
text: O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’

speaker: god
name: God
text: Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,

speaker: jacob
text: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant. Indeed, with only my staff I came across the Jordan, but now I have become two camps.

speaker: jacob
text: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.

speaker: jacob
text: But You have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper, and I will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count.’

speaker: god
text: I will surely make you prosper, and I will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count.

speaker: jacob
text: Go on ahead of me, and keep some distance between the herds.

speaker: jacob
text: When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘To whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you?’

speaker: esau
name: Esau
text: To whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you?

speaker: jacob
text: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift, sent to my lord Esau. And behold, Jacob is behind us.’

speaker: jacobs-lead-servant
name: Jacob’s lead servant
text: They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift, sent to my lord Esau. And behold, Jacob is behind us.

speaker: jacob
text: When you meet Esau, you are to say the same thing to him.

speaker: jacob
text: You are also to say, ‘Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.’

speaker: jacobs-servants
name: Jacob’s servants
text: Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.

speaker: jacob
text: I will appease Esau with the gift that is going before me. After that I can face him, and perhaps he will accept me.

speaker: man-wrestling-jacob
name: The man who wrestled with Jacob
text: Let me go, for it is daybreak.

speaker: jacob
text: I will not let you go unless you bless me.

speaker: man-wrestling-jacob
text: What is your name?

speaker: jacob
text: Jacob,

speaker: man-wrestling-jacob
text: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men, and you have prevailed.

speaker: jacob
text: Please tell me your name.

speaker: man-wrestling-jacob
text: Why do you ask my name?

speaker: jacob
text: Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.

speaker: esau
name: Esau
text: Who are these with you?

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: These are the children God has graciously given your servant.

speaker: esau
text: What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?

speaker: jacob
text: To find favor in your sight, my lord,

speaker: esau
text: I already have plenty, my brother,

speaker: esau
text: Keep what belongs to you.

speaker: jacob
text: No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.

speaker: jacob
text: Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.

speaker: esau
text: Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.

speaker: jacob
text: My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.

speaker: jacob
text: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.

speaker: esau
text: Let me leave some of my people with you,

speaker: jacob
text: Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.

speaker: shechem
name: Shechem
text: Get me this girl as a wife.

speaker: hamor
name: Hamor
text: My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.

speaker: hamor
text: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters, and take our daughters for yourselves.

speaker: hamor
text: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.

speaker: shechem
text: Grant me this favor, and I will give you whatever you ask.

speaker: shechem
text: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!

speaker: jacobs-sons
name: Jacob’s sons
text: We cannot do such a thing,

speaker: jacobs-sons
text: To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.

speaker: jacobs-sons
text: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.

speaker: jacobs-sons
text: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.

speaker: jacobs-sons
text: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.

speaker: hamor-and-shechem
name: Hamor and Shechem
text: These men are at peace with us. Let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.

speaker: hamor-and-shechem
text: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.

speaker: hamor-and-shechem
text: Will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land. We are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.

speaker: simeon-and-levi
name: Simeon and Levi
text: Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?

speaker: god
name: God
text: Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. Purify yourselves and change your garments.

speaker: jacob
text: Then let us arise and go to Bethel. I will build an altar there to God, who answered me in my day of distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone.

speaker: god
text: Though your name is Jacob, you will no longer be called Jacob. Instead, your name will be Israel.

speaker: god
text: I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation—even a company of nations—shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.

speaker: god
text: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.

speaker: rachels-midwife
name: Rachel’s midwife
text: Do not be afraid, for you are having another son.

speaker: joseph
name: Joseph
text: Listen to this dream I had:

speaker: joseph
text: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.

speaker: josephs-brothers
name: Joseph’s brothers
text: Do you intend to reign over us?

speaker: josephs-brothers
text: Will you actually rule us?

speaker: joseph
text: Look,

speaker: joseph
text: I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.

speaker: jacob
name: Jacob (Israel)
text: What is this dream that you have had? Will your mother and brothers and I actually come and bow down to the ground before you?

speaker: jacob
text: Are not your brothers pasturing the flocks at Shechem? Get ready; I am sending you to them.

speaker: joseph
text: I am ready,

speaker: jacob
text: Go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me.

speaker: unnamed-man
name: An unnamed man
text: What are you looking for?

speaker: joseph
text: I am looking for my brothers,

speaker: joseph
text: Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?

speaker: unnamed-man
text: They have moved on from here,

speaker: unnamed-man
text: I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’

speaker: josephs-brothers
text: Let us go to Dothan.

speaker: josephs-brothers
text: Here comes that dreamer!

speaker: josephs-brothers
text: Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. We can say that a vicious animal has devoured him. Then we shall see what becomes of his dreams!

speaker: reuben
name: Reuben
text: Let us not take his life,

speaker: reuben
text: Do not shed his blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him.

speaker: judah
name: Judah
text: What profit will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?

speaker: judah
text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh.

speaker: reuben
text: The boy is gone! What am I going to do?

speaker: josephs-brothers
text: We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe or not.

speaker: jacob
text: It is my son’s robe! A vicious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!

speaker: jacob
text: No,

speaker: jacob
text: I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.

speaker: judah
name: Judah
text: Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.

speaker: judah
text: Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.

speaker: judah
text: He may die too, like his brothers.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,

speaker: judah
text: Come now, let me sleep with you.

speaker: tamar
name: Tamar
text: What will you give me for sleeping with you?

speaker: judah
text: I will send you a young goat from my flock,

speaker: tamar
text: Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.

speaker: judah
text: What pledge should I give you?

speaker: tamar
text: Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.

speaker: hirah
name: Hirah
text: Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?

speaker: men-of-enaim
name: The men of Enaim
text: No shrine prostitute has been here,

speaker: hirah
text: I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’

speaker: men-of-enaim
text: No shrine prostitute has been here.

speaker: judah
text: Let her keep the items,

speaker: judah
text: Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.

speaker: unnamed-informants
text: Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.

speaker: judah
text: Bring her out!

speaker: judah
text: Let her be burned to death!

speaker: tamar
text: I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.

speaker: tamar
text: Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?

speaker: judah
text: She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.

speaker: tamars-midwife
name: Tamar’s midwife
text: This one came out first,

speaker: tamars-midwife
text: You have broken out first!

speaker: potiphars-wife
name: Potiphar’s wife
text: Sleep with me.

speaker: joseph
name: Joseph
text: Look,

speaker: joseph
text: with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care.

speaker: joseph
text: No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: Sleep with me!

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: Look,

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. He came to me so he could sleep with me, but I screamed as loud as I could.

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: The Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me,

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: but when I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.

speaker: potiphars-wife
text: This is what your slave did to me,

speaker: joseph
name: Joseph
text: Why are your faces so downcast today?

speaker: cupbearer-and-baker
name: The chief cupbearer and the chief baker
text: We both had dreams,

speaker: cupbearer-and-baker
text: but there is no one to interpret them.

speaker: joseph
text: Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
name: The chief cupbearer
text: In my dream there was a vine before me,

speaker: chief-cupbearer
text: and on the vine were three branches. As it budded, its blossoms opened and its clusters ripened into grapes.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
text: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into his cup, and placed the cup in his hand.

speaker: joseph
text: This is the interpretation: The three branches are three days.

speaker: joseph
text: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore your position. You will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.

speaker: joseph
text: But when it goes well for you, please remember me and show me kindness by mentioning me to Pharaoh, that he might bring me out of this prison.

speaker: joseph
text: For I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.

speaker: chief-baker
name: The chief baker
text: I too had a dream: There were three baskets of white bread on my head.

speaker: chief-baker
text: In the top basket were all sorts of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.

speaker: joseph
text: This is the interpretation: The three baskets are three days.

speaker: joseph
text: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. Then the birds will eat the flesh of your body.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
name: The chief cupbearer
text: Today I recall my failures.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
text: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he put me and the chief baker in the custody of the captain of the guard.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
text: One night both the chief baker and I had dreams, and each dream had its own meaning.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
text: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually.

speaker: chief-cupbearer
